name: RUN!!! IV
summary: No explicit Chip tile; native MS nevertheless creates the player at (0,0). 1029 raw chips cover the 999 requirement, so missing start is not an impossibility proof.
limitations: No winning replay and no universal impossibility proof established. Data counts or unsuccessful play are not treated as impossibility.

experiments.result: Decoded both 1024-cell DAT planes and exact level metadata; initialized production MS runtime and rendered actual game sprites.

experiments.method: Nearest-chip route with a four-tick survival check for each next action; one seed and stepping setting, no seed/parameter sweep.
experiments.result: 167 chips collected by tick 667;832 remain. Stopped at (24,5) after all five local four-tick movement/wait choices were lethal. This does not establish impossibility.
